title: Decouple UI and Business Logic
problem_statement: Legacy VB6 forms tightly couple UI controls with business logic, hindering maintainability and testability.
risk_if_unaddressed: Continued difficulty in maintaining and evolving application; increased defect rates.
suggested_approach: Refactor business logic into separate C# service classes; implement MVVM or MVC pattern for UI.
success_criteria: Business logic is fully separated from UI code
UI forms call service layer via defined interfaces
Automated unit tests cover business logic

provenance.evidence: Command buttons directly invoke other forms or actions.

title: Implement Secure Authentication and Password Storage
problem_statement: Legacy password handling lacks secure storage and authentication mechanisms.
risk_if_unaddressed: User credentials vulnerable to compromise; non-compliance with security standards.
suggested_approach: Adopt ASP.NET Identity or equivalent; implement salted hashing and secure password reset flows.
success_criteria: Passwords never stored or transmitted in plaintext
Authentication uses secure protocols and frameworks
User login functionality covered by automated tests

provenance.evidence: PasswordChar used but no secure storage evident.

title: Migrate Data Access to Parameterized Queries or ORM
problem_statement: Legacy use of ADO/DAO with potential concatenated SQL queries risks SQL injection.
risk_if_unaddressed: Application vulnerable to SQL injection attacks and data integrity issues.
suggested_approach: Replace legacy data access with Entity Framework or Dapper using parameterized queries.
success_criteria: No concatenated SQL strings with user input
All data access covered by integration tests
Performance benchmarks meet or exceed legacy system

title: Establish Automated Testing Framework
problem_statement: No automated tests exist for legacy VB6 business logic and UI.
risk_if_unaddressed: High risk of regression and defects during modernization and future changes.
suggested_approach: Implement unit and integration tests using MSTest, NUnit, or xUnit for C# code.
success_criteria: Test coverage metrics meet enterprise standards
Continuous integration runs tests on each commit
Defects detected early in development cycle
